concepts.title: Laws of Reflection
concepts.ncert_text: (i) The angle of incidence is equal to the angle of reflection. (ii) The incident ray, the normal to the mirror at the point of incidence and the reflected ray, all lie in the same plane.

concepts.title: Mirror Formula
concepts.ncert_text: 1/v + 1/u = 1/f. Here u is object distance, v is image distance and f is focal length. The magnification m = -v/u = h'/h.

concepts.title: Refractive Index
concepts.ncert_text: The refractive index of medium 2 with respect to medium 1 (n21) = speed of light in medium 1 / speed of light in medium 2. Absolute refractive index n = c/v.

concepts.title: Snell's Law
concepts.ncert_text: The ratio of sine of angle of incidence to the sine of angle of refraction is a constant, for the light of a given colour and for the given pair of media. sin i / sin r = constant.

concepts.title: Lens Formula
concepts.ncert_text: 1/v - 1/u = 1/f. Magnification m = v/u = h'/h. Power of lens P = 1/f (in metres). Unit of power is Dioptre (D).
